summary: Quantitative Investment & Risk Analyst candidate with ~7 years in investment analytics, portfolio analytics, and risk analytics for asset managers, pension funds, and institutional portfolios. Delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs ($5–25bn per engagement); built an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine and production Python analytics pipelines with SQL (PostgreSQL) in daily use. VaR/CVaR portfolio optimization, risk decomposition, and stochastic scenario analysis at Ortec Finance. CFA charterholder; dual MSc.
core_skills: Vendor Risk & Data Platforms (PFaroe, Ortec GLASS)

sections.heading: Investment & Risk Analytics for Portfolio Decisions
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement, cumulatively covering ~$50bn of client assets.

Investigate performance and risk outcomes across portfolios — validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, and cross-check sensitivities and scenario impacts for institutional clients including pension funds, asset managers, and their portfolio managers.
Review curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release; escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility.

sections.heading: Data-to-Insight Workflow, Reporting & Automation
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across portfolio horizons.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, data quality and validation controls — reusable, analysis-ready outputs in production across the modelling team.

Oversaw interest-rate and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel shocks; prepared analytical commentary translating quantitative outputs into investment-committee-ready risk reports for senior stakeholders.

sections.heading: AI-Enabled Automation & Documentation
bullets: Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation — reduced cycle time ~30–40% on comparable modules.
Operate within a formal model governance framework — independent review and challenge, documentation and benchmarking standards, and assessment of model performance for client-delivered analytics.
Led onboarding and implementation of PFaroe DB and PFaroe PM — vendor risk and analytics platforms — for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms.

Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product/development functions — translated analytical requirements into clear, testable documentation for development teams, defined business logic for asset, liability, and ALM configurations, and validated implementations post-deployment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients — aligned liability measurement and reporting frameworks with system implementation.
Advised actuarial, finance, IT, and risk functions on governance documentation, model controls, and regulatory readiness.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization based on VaR and CVaR on Ortec's GLASS platform; conducted risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk, and near-optimal frontier robustness analysis across funds and portfolios.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators (Monte Carlo) assessing interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk under base and stressed environments.

Delivered ALM and portfolio analytics studies for Canadian and international pension funds — analyzed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk alongside all major investment-product types.
Presented findings to investment committees on Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation through stress and sensitivity testing — concise, decision-focused analysis for investment leadership.
Led onboarding and the ALM study for the University Pension Plan (UPP) three-plan merger — developed and validated the model evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
